title: Media
description: Rights metadata. External URL allowed. Embedded images only as hotlinked image_url with a verified open license (D-2026-10-20-01). Unverified uploads forbidden. No forged artifact images.

caption.description: Factual caption: what is depicted; institution/accession only if the source gives it; casts/replicas must say so

external_url.description: Source page (Commons file page / museum object page) or outbound link

image_url.description: Hotlinked full image on the official host; requires rights.status=rights-cleared + open license (export_check embed gate)

thumb_url.description: Hotlinked thumbnail on the official host

local_path.description: Must be null in v0 — unverified uploads forbidden
